conventions.imports: Direct @/ path per file — no TS barrel. Prefer existing catalog entry over new markup.
conventions.dualUi: Never mix React settings components into public/ popups or vice versa.

styling.react: Semantic Tailwind from shared/theme.ts via src/index.css CSS vars; merge with cn() from @/lib/utils. Skill: ui-theme.
styling.popups: --popup-* from theme.popup in public/css/base.css; user bg/text/transparency via public/js/shared/theme.js. Skill: ui-theme.

react-settings.notes: HSL channel vars for Tailwind @theme. Semantic utilities only (bg-primary, text-warning, text-2xs). Primary teal ~173 58% 36%.

vanilla-popups.notes: Hex/rgba --popup-* tokens generated from theme.popup. Conceptually teal brand matches React primary; not a shared stylesheet.

components.name: Button
components.when: Any settings action, confirm, dismiss, or icon button
components.avoid: Raw <button> with one-off Tailwind in settings UI

components.name: Badge
components.when: Compact chips (tier, flair, achievement counts) on profile / achievements; streak shield on Goals; Camera Setup capture-status chip (live / preview / idle / error)
components.avoid: Copy-pasted rounded border teal/primary chip spans; do not invent a second chip atom
components.notes: Classes from theme.recipe.chip; extra modifiers via className (uppercase, tabular-nums). Camera Setup uses role=status + className for idle/preview/error.

components.name: ToggleSwitch
components.when: Boolean preference toggles in SettingRow action slot
components.avoid: Custom checkbox/switch markup for prefs

components.name: RangeSlider
components.when: Numeric interval/volume/duration sliders with gradient fill
components.avoid: Copy-pasted <input type=range> + linear-gradient style
components.a11y: required aria-label; pair with visible value badge in parent
components.notes: Fill uses cssColor("primary") / cssColor("muted") from shared/theme. Override height via className (e.g. h-1.5 flex-1).

components.name: Select
components.when: Any settings dropdown (locale, notification style, blink profile, camera device, running-app picker)
components.avoid: Native <select> / duplicate chevron wrappers in settings UI
components.a11y: role=combobox + listbox; aria-expanded; aria-activedescendant; option rows role=option
components.notes: Portals the menu to document.body so TabbedSection overflow does not clip. Open/close uses theme.recipe.dialog / theme.recipe.exit. Optional option.description for longer copy (blink profile).

components.name: SummaryStat
components.when: Compact label + numeric value tiles in stats/profile grids
components.avoid: Private duplicate SummaryStat in feature panels

components.name: SettingGrid
components.when: 1→2 column responsive layout for SettingPanels or SummaryStats
components.avoid: Ad-hoc grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 wrappers

components.name: SettingPanel
components.when: Card container for a settings block
components.avoid: Custom bordered card shells in features

components.name: SettingRow
components.when: Title + description + optional action (toggle/select) + optional body
components.avoid: Hand-rolled title/description/action flex rows

components.name: SectionTabs
components.when: Full-width accessible tablist (e.g. Progress, Camera, Reminders, Settings, About, Debug)
components.avoid: New segmented tab bars; prefer this over one-off button groups when tabs switch sections. Wrap with tabbed-section for sticky chrome + keyed scroller
components.notes: Feature-local RangeButton in statistics-panel is for chart range chips only — do not promote unless reused.

components.name: TabbedSection
components.when: Sticky SectionTabs chrome + keyed content scroller for a settings page (Camera, Progress, Reminders, Settings, About, Debug)
components.avoid: Hand-rolling a second tablist+overflow column; Exercises and Appearance stay single-scroll
components.notes: Also exports MAIN_SCROLL_CLASS for the leftover exercises/appearance scroller. Tab state is session-only — not a preference.

components.name: StatusBanner
components.when: Inline status/alert shells (errors, warnings, notices)
components.avoid: Duplicate rounded-lg border amber/destructive banners
components.notes: Shell only — compose icon/title/body/dismiss inside children. Warning variant uses theme.recipe.warningSurface.

components.name: Reveal
components.when: Show/hide nested settings, banners, or confirm blocks (toggle extras, collapsible editors, status that mounts/unmounts)
components.avoid: Hand-rolled {open ? … : null} for settings extras; do not use for section/tab page swaps (TabbedSection already enters)
components.notes: collapse = height 0fr/1fr (keeps fields mounted). fade = presence + motion-enter/exit. Honor prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: TrackingEyeButton
components.when: Sidebar Lottie eye start/stop tracking control
components.avoid: Second floating tracking FAB

components.name: LiveBlinkRate
components.when: Animated live BPM + quality meter on statistics
components.avoid: Rebuilding live rate meter elsewhere

components.name: StatsBarChart
components.when: Simple blink bucket bar chart
components.avoid: Pulling chart libraries for this shape

components.name: SimpleMarkdown
components.when: Lightweight markdown for release notes
components.avoid: Full markdown libs for About content

components.name: UpdateToast
components.when: Non-blocking update available toast
components.avoid: Second toast system

components.name: CameraErrorBanner
components.when: Camera sidecar error with dismiss
components.avoid: Inlining destructive banner markup in app shell

components.name: CameraCalibrationBanner
components.when: Camera settings: stale or drift recalibrate hint with Recalibrate + Dismiss
components.avoid: A second interruptive modal; toast is click-through and has no CTA

components.name: EyePromptsDisabledNotice
components.when: Both eye exercises and look-away are off

components.name: EyeCareIndependenceSettings
components.when: Exercises section: toggle eye-care independent of blink Start/Stop reminders
components.avoid: Duplicating this toggle inside ExerciseSettings or LookAwaySettings; one shared pref for both

components.name: SettingsShell
components.when: Nav shell, section routing, overlays. Compose TabbedSection here for Reminders (Schedule/Pause), Camera (via CameraSection), Progress, and Settings (General/Data). About and Debug own TabbedSection internally. Vite entry remains src/app.tsx (BlinkGuardHomepage + I18nProvider).
components.avoid: Second settings shell or nav reorder that puts Debug before last

components.name: ReminderControls
components.when: Reminders → Schedule tab: camera miss-gap or timer micro-break interval + blinkPromptProfile + start/stop + snooze
components.notes: Camera on → 1–10s reminderInterval; camera off → 15–120s microBreakInterval (default 30s). Profile uses Select (`blinkPromptProfile`) with per-option description. IPC: updateInterval / updateMicroBreakInterval / updateBlinkPromptProfile.

components.name: CameraDevicePicker
components.when: Camera settings: choose capture device + refresh OS inventory
components.avoid: A raw device dropdown in camera-setup-panel; do not add a picker to the vanilla camera popup

components.name: CameraControls
components.when: Camera section composer: error + calibration banners and Setup or Tuning panel
components.avoid: Inlining camera setup/tuning markup in settings-shell.tsx

components.name: CameraSetupPanel
components.when: Camera → Setup tab: detection, preview, auto-stop, device picker, quality
components.avoid: Duplicating these controls on Tuning

components.name: CameraTuningPanel
components.when: Camera → Tuning tab: EAR/classifier calibration, nudge toggle, MGD, low-BPM ladder boost (`blinkRateCoachingEnabled`)
components.avoid: Duplicating these controls on Setup; calibration IPC state lives in use-camera-calibration; do not add a standalone coach-toast control

components.name: CameraCalibrationSettings
components.when: Camera Tuning: EAR + personal classifier calibration controls (start/cancel/reset, progress)

components.name: ExerciseSettings
components.when: Eye exercise toggle, interval, prompt list

components.name: LookAwaySettings
components.when: Look-away toggle, interval/duration, prompt fields

components.name: PopupSettings
components.when: Popup message/colors/preview (Appearance)
components.notes: Private ColorSetting is feature-local — extract only if a second color picker appears.

components.name: PopupPresetSettings
components.when: Appearance: equip/clear shop popup glow presets

components.name: NotificationStyleSettings
components.when: Appearance: overlay / native / both prompt style, between PopupSettings and SoundSettings
components.avoid: A second copy on Reminders → Pause

components.name: StatisticsPanel
components.when: Progress → Statistics tab (live rate, today, eye-care table, chart, clear)
components.notes: Private RangeButton for chart range chips — feature-local. Wallet totals live on Rewards/Profile; goals progress + streak live on goals-settings.

components.name: ProfilePanel
components.when: Progress → Profile tab

components.name: AchievementsPanel
components.when: Progress → Achievements tab
components.notes: Collapsible category groups (start/progression/habit/explore) with N/M counters; feature-local achievement cards with lucide icons; count badge also on Profile.

components.name: ProfileShareCard
components.when: Canvas PNG share-card render + content resolve for Profile export
components.avoid: Duplicating share-card layout in the dialog or main export path

components.name: ProfileShareDialog
components.when: Share card preview modal before PNG export

components.name: RewardsShopPanel
components.when: Progress → Rewards tab

components.name: AppearanceSelect
components.when: Sidebar and header Light / System / Night chrome icons (not overlay popupColors). Click expands an animated row in that order; opening from Light/Night recenters the trio on the button; labels are long-press hints only.
components.avoid: Select dropdown for app chrome theme; binary dark-mode toggle; putting app chrome theme on the Appearance nav; visible text labels on the icons; pinning the open row to a trailing edge

components.name: SoundSettings
components.when: Settings → sound enable + volume

components.name: LanguageSettings
components.when: Settings → General tab: locale select

components.name: LaunchAtLoginSettings
components.when: Settings → General tab: launch at login

components.name: SessionRecapSettings
components.when: Settings → General tab: session recap enable toggle

components.name: CheerSoundSettings
components.when: Appearance: equip cheer theme (shop unlocks + free themes)

components.name: ResetPreferencesButton
components.when: Settings → Data tab: danger zone reset

components.name: SettingsProfilesPanel
components.when: Settings → Data tab: named setups (catalog key settingsProfiles.title; UK label in uk.ts); list/save/rename/delete/switch via invoke only
components.avoid: Calling this feature "profile" in UI copy (conflicts with Progress profile); fanning out update-* / pushPreferenceDiff on switch; new dialog atom (use inline SettingPanel confirm like Backup/Reset)

components.name: BackupSettings
components.when: Settings → Data tab: export/import backup JSON

components.name: QuietHoursFocusSettings
components.when: Reminders → Pause tab: quiet hours (default From/To + seven weekday rows), fullscreen pause, per-app blocklist, and session-idle (lid/display-off) status
components.avoid: A second dialog or Start-Menu installed-app browser; do not chip-reveal one weekday

components.name: QuietHoursWeekdayRow
components.when: One weekday inherit / off / custom quiet-hours row under QuietHoursFocusSettings
components.avoid: Shared atom for day rows until a second consumer appears

components.name: GoalsSettings
components.when: Progress → Statistics: goals config, progress bars, and streak
components.notes: Private GoalNumberInput and GoalProgressRow are feature-local.

components.name: ShortcutSettings
components.when: Global shortcut capture UI (Settings → General)

components.name: OnboardingWizard
components.when: First-run overlay when !hasCompletedOnboarding (language → mode → shortcut → quiet/focus → ready)

components.name: AboutPanel
components.when: About → Overview/Notes/Thanks tabs (version, GitHub, diagnostics, updates)

components.name: ReleaseNotesPanel
components.when: About → Notes tab (GitHub releases; fetch only while selected)

components.name: ThanksPanel
components.when: About → Thanks tab

components.name: UpdateDialog
components.when: Blocking update available / install modal

components.name: DebugPanel
components.when: DEV-only Debug nav (must stay last): Preview / Tools tabs

components.name: DebugCleanButton
components.when: Debug Preview/Tools boxes that spawn leftover overlays or sounds — title-row dismiss
components.avoid: Mixing Clean into the overlay/sound kind chip row; using shop Clear for overlay dismiss
components.notes: Sends debugCleanPreview: close leftover overlays/cheer toast and stop sounds. Same action on every relevant box.

components.name: DebugPreviewPanel
components.when: Debug → Preview tab: overlay + sound buttons
components.avoid: Duplicating overlay/sound buttons on Tools

components.name: DebugToolsPanel
components.when: Debug → Tools tab: shop cheats, profile level, achievement previews, EAR-trace, replay onboarding
components.avoid: Duplicating these controls on Preview

components.name: Settings page scrollbar
components.import: Global in src/index.css — do not hide scrollbars per feature
components.when: React settings overflow (main pane, tabbed scrollers, share dialog, mobile nav)
components.avoid: scrollbar-width: none / ::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none }; a React scrollbar component; styling popup scrollbars here
components.notes: Thin 8px bar; thumb hsl(--border), hover/active primary/0.55; no Windows arrow buttons. Main overflow-y-auto wrappers also use scrollbar-gutter: stable.

components.name: .popup-glass
components.when: Frosted popup panels (blur underlay, sharp text)
components.avoid: backdrop-filter on the same layer as text; BrowserWindow.setOpacity for panel glass

components.name: .popup-enter
components.import: class="… popup-enter" on the popup card (not the BrowserWindow)
components.when: Exercise, look-away, calibration nudge, no-face, editor, and other overlay cards that should fade/rise in
components.avoid: BrowserWindow.setOpacity; looping motion on blink stay-until-blink cards; skipping prefers-reduced-motion
components.notes: 220ms fade + 6px rise + slight scale. Honor prefers-reduced-motion in base.css. Cheer/ambient keep their own keyframes.

components.name: theme.js helpers
components.when: Live popup colors, transparency alpha surfaces, reminder message, camera-mode class
components.avoid: Hardcoding colors that prefs already push via theme.js

components.name: popup i18n.js
components.when: Any user-visible popup copy
components.avoid: Hardcoded-only strings without data-i18n + EN/UK keys

components.name: popup-a11y.js
components.when: Interactive blink / exercise / look-away dialogs (Esc, Tab cycle, primary focus after i18n)
components.avoid: Click-through blink/exercise/look-away, cheer, ambient, calibration nudge, no-face — HTML live status only, no dialog or focus

components.name: Reminder card pattern
components.when: Blink / starting / stopped reminder overlays
components.avoid: Rebuilding reminder chrome in React; do not 2.5s-auto-close blink overlays in CSS animation alone — stay/dismiss is ReminderService-owned

components.name: Ambient peripheral glow
components.when: Gentle blinkPromptProfile first step — click-through workArea wash on the active display
components.avoid: Centered reminder-card; BrowserWindow.setOpacity; inventing new --popup-* tokens (reuse --popup-accent / --popup-warning); coach HTML

components.name: Exercise / look-away dialog pattern
components.when: Timed eye-care action dialogs
components.avoid: React reimplementation; note CSS twins — prefer aligning classes if consolidating, not a React wrapper

components.name: Soft toast chip
components.when: Small bordered toast overlays (no-face, calibration-nudge)
components.avoid: Full reminder-card for tiny status chips; do not revive blink-rate-coach.html — CSS file is nudge-only now

components.name: Cheer stage
components.when: Celebration overlay (cheer, level-up, achievement, achievementSummary)
components.avoid: Reuse for non-celebration toasts

components.name: Popup editor chrome
components.when: Position/size editor only (Save / Save all / Set up next display / Cancel)
components.avoid: Using editor chrome classes on normal reminders

components.name: Camera HUD overlays
components.when: Camera preview/debug HUD
components.avoid: Settings camera UI (that is React CameraControls)

components.name: Tray menu popup
components.when: Right-click themed tray popup (Show/Start-Stop, Hush, Snooze, Setups, pause-for-app)
components.avoid: Native Menu for the themed chrome; inventing hush prefs; React reimplementation

components.name: Session recap overlay
components.when: Desk session recap overlay on qualified stop/idle (native lock/quit is OsNotificationPlayer)
components.avoid: React recap UI; treating recap as a reminder-card clone

featureLocal.notes: Private RangeButton for chart range chips — keep local unless reused.
Private ColorSetting — extract only if a second color picker is needed.
Private GoalNumberInput and GoalProgressRow are feature-local.
Canvas PNG builder (not a React component).
